#!/usr/bin/env bash
# BeyondRGB WebSocket test runner
# Usage: bash ws-1-liners.txt [PORT] [CORPUS_DIR]
# Requires: pip install websocket-client
set -euo pipefail

PORT="${1:-9500}"
CORPUS="${2:-$HOME/work/copilot/pr-418/test-corpus}"
FUZZ="${3:-$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)/fuzz/graphics/tif}"

echo "=== BeyondRGB WebSocket Tests ==="
echo "Port:   $PORT"
echo "Corpus: $CORPUS"
echo "Fuzz:   $FUZZ"
echo ""

# Shared helper — sends request, collects all frames, prints result
ws_test() {
  local label="$1" expect="$2" payload="$3"
  echo "--- [$label] (expect: $expect) ---"
  python3 -c "
import websocket, json, sys
try:
    ws = websocket.create_connection('ws://localhost:${PORT}', timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    print(f'CONNECT FAILED: {e}'); sys.exit(1)
ws.send(json.dumps(${payload}))
resps, binary_total = [], 0
try:
    while True:
        op, r = ws.recv_data()
        if op == websocket.ABNF.OPCODE_TEXT:
            try:
                resps.append(json.loads(r))
            except Exception:
                resps.append({'_raw_text': r.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[:200]})
        else:
            binary_total += len(r)
except Exception:
    pass
ws.close()
for r in resps:
    rd = r.get('ResponseData', {})
    if rd.get('critical') or 'message' in rd:
        print(f'  ERROR: {rd.get(\"message\", \"(no message)\")}')
        trace = rd.get('trace', '')
        if trace:
            for line in trace.strip().split('\n')[:8]:
                print(f'    {line}')
            total = len(trace.strip().split('\n'))
            if total > 8: print(f'    ... ({total} frames total)')
    elif '_raw_text' in r:
        print(f'  TEXT: {r[\"_raw_text\"]}')
    else:
        keys = list(rd.keys()) if rd else []
        print(f'  JSON: RequestID={r.get(\"RequestID\")}, keys={keys}')
if binary_total:
    print(f'  BINARY: {binary_total} bytes received')
if not resps and not binary_total:
    print(f'  NO RESPONSE (server may have crashed)')
" 2>&1
  echo ""
}

# --- Tests ---

# 1. 16-bit TIFF — native format, should succeed
ws_test "1: 16-bit TIFF" "success" \
  "{'RequestID':1,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_16bit_depth.tiff']}}"

# 2. Standard RGB TIFF — should succeed
ws_test "2: Standard RGB" "success" \
  "{'RequestID':2,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_standard_rgb.tiff']}}"

# 3. Big-endian TIFF — tests byte order handling
ws_test "3: Big-endian TIFF" "success" \
  "{'RequestID':3,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_Big_Endian.tiff']}}"

# 4. Little-endian TIFF
ws_test "4: Little-endian TIFF" "success" \
  "{'RequestID':4,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_Little_Endian.tiff']}}"

# 5. CMYK TIFF — BeyondRGB requires RGB
ws_test "5: CMYK TIFF" "error" \
  "{'RequestID':5,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_cmyk.tiff']}}"

# 6. 32-bit float TIFF — must be 16-bit integer
ws_test "6: 32-bit float" "error" \
  "{'RequestID':6,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_32bit_float4.tiff']}}"

# 7. Grayscale TIFF — single channel, not RGB
ws_test "7: Grayscale" "error" \
  "{'RequestID':7,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_grayscale.tiff']}}"

# 8. Alpha channel TIFF — tests RGBA handling
ws_test "8: Alpha channel" "error-or-success" \
  "{'RequestID':8,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_alpha_channel.tiff']}}"

# 9. Malformed fuzz TIFF — sanitizer stress test
ws_test "9: Fuzz TIFF" "error" \
  "{'RequestID':9,'RequestType':'HalfSizePreview','RequestData':{'names':['${FUZZ}/bar.tif']}}"

# 10. Thumbnails batch — 3 images, multiple binary frames expected
ws_test "10: Thumbnails batch" "binary-frames" \
  "{'RequestID':10,'RequestType':'Thumbnails','RequestData':{'names':['${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_16bit_depth.tiff','${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_standard_rgb.tiff','${CORPUS}/fuzzed_image_Big_Endian.tiff']}}"

echo "=== Done ==="
